unit.why: A short anecdote, drawn from a letter quoted in Shem ha-Gedolim he-Hadash, in which the Hafla'ah asks, through intermediaries, that the Noda bi-Yehuda stop distressing R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotshov, citing R. Shmelke's testimony; it is minimal but it does report an event of intercession in a conflict.

stories.start_quote: בשה״ג החדש מר׳ גדולים מערכה פ׳.
stories.end_quote: אל יבטל אותו צדיק מעבודתו עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The author of the Hafla'ah writes, through R. Tevli of Lissa and R. Yosef of Posen, asking the Noda bi-Yehuda not to trouble R. Yehiel Michel of Zlotshov, since R. Shmelke of Nikolsburg testified that all his intentions are for the sake of Heaven.

quotes: שיבקש מחותנו הגה״ק בעל נודע ביהודא זצ"ל שאל יצער
tags.why: The Noda bi-Yehuda, a non-Hasidic rabbinic authority, is troubling the Hasidic maggid.

quotes: שאל יצער להה״ק מו"ה יחיאל מיכל זצ״ל מזלאטשוב
tags.why: The Noda bi-Yehuda is in conflict with R. Michel.

quotes: לכן אל יבטל אותו צדיק מעבודתו
tags.why: Defends the tsaddik's service against interference; this is borderline for the doctrine-of-the-tsaddik tag.
Testimony to the purity of the tsaddik's intentions.
The point of the anecdote is to vouch for R. Michel's sincerity.

intercession by rabbinic peers on a tsaddik's behalf
testimony or vouching for a tsaddik's sincerity
